pros: Offers feel-good features like sunroof, 360 degree camera and 9-inch touchscreen.
Ground clearance: 163mm is more than enough to drive easily over rough roads.
High mileage: Returns around 15-16 kmpl in the city in regular driving conditions.
Excellent boot space. Can store an entire suitcase set along with two soft bags.
Safety package: 5-star Global NCAP crash test rating and 6 airbags as standard.
Looks distinctive: New design elements give it an identity different from the Swift.
Comfortable ride quality: Cushioned over regular imperfections, and limits movement on sharper potholes too.
cons: AMT transmission: Slow and jerky on the highway, and upshifts quite early leaving less usable power.
Low engine refinement and performance: Feels dull with a full load and overtakes require planning.
Limited headroom: Sloping roofline limits headroom for 6-footers.
